name: release-cold-boot-first-battle
root_note: Two fresh cold-boot runs on the pinned .gba + in-worktree worker produced this identical savestate SHA-256.
purpose: Cold-boot the pinned release ROM with set_keys, walk the release intro and Littleroot, and stop at the first battle (gBattleTypeFlags != 0). Every hop after CB2_Overworld is condition-driven; each milestone hop writes a hashed savestate outside Git.

root_settle.note: after gBattleTypeFlags turns nonzero, wait (bounded) for the first battler to load; the battle then sits stable waiting for the player's first action

steps.name: boot-to-title
steps.note: cold boot through the intro movie

steps.name: skip-intro
steps.note: START skips the intro to title init

steps.name: title-to-overworld
steps.note: mash A: title -> main menu -> NEW GAME -> Birch speech -> naming -> gender -> CB2_NewGame

steps.name: truck-walk-right
steps.note: truck controls unlock ~850 frames after CB2_Overworld, then RIGHT reaches the intro trigger

steps.name: truck-default-settings
steps.note: the trigger script's dialog is A-driven; no flag/var changes, so this hop is frame-bounded

steps.name: truck-exit-warp
steps.note: RIGHT off the truck into Littleroot Town

steps.name: intro-move-in
steps.note: LittlerootTown OnFrame auto-walks the player and Mom into the house; A clears the dialogs

steps.name: face-clock
steps.note: turn north against the wall so the wall-clock sign is in front; no observable state changes

steps.name: clock-open-ui
steps.note: dismiss the 'clock is stopped' box and open the wall-clock UI

steps.name: clock-set
steps.note: UP then A on separate frames: the yes/no menu starts on NO, so UP must move to YES first

steps.name: tv-scene
steps.note: 1F OnFrame auto-runs the Petalburg Gym TV report

steps.name: rival-house-1f-neighbor
steps.note: the 1F 'new neighbor' event locks controls and is A-driven; alternate A and UP

steps.name: meet-rival
steps.note: face DOWN at the rival's Poke Ball and mash A; clears FLAG_HIDE_LITTLEROOT_TOWN_BIRCHS_LAB_BIRCH

steps.name: lab-face-birch
steps.note: turn north against Birch; no observable state changes

steps.name: lab-talk-birch
steps.note: A sets FLAG_TOUCHED_BALLS and opens the custom ChangeStarters menu

steps.name: lab-close-birch-menu
steps.note: B dismisses the dynmultistack menu; it holds sLockFieldControls=1 until closed

steps.name: lab-settle
steps.note: B/A dismiss the post-menu text; A must not linger facing Birch or his menu reopens

steps.name: lab-face-ball
steps.note: turn north onto the Poke Ball on the table; no observable state changes

steps.name: lab-take-starter
steps.note: A answers YES to the starter prompt and fills the party

steps.name: lab-decline-nickname
steps.note: B declines the nickname prompt

steps.name: lab-exit
steps.note: B clears the post-starter text while DOWN walks to the lab door

steps.name: to-route101-up
steps.note: VAR_LITTLEROOT_TOWN_STATE is now 2, so the NeedPokemonTrigger no longer fires
walk back and forth in the tall-grass patch; run_route stops early when gBattleTypeFlags != 0
